text:
Ana: heads-up — noticed a ~1.6% delta between CloudVendor marketplace usage and our ingestion this morning. some webhook payloads failing verification (sig mismatch). anyone on call for marketplace metering?
Chris: saw the alert. spikes align with a retry wave at 05:12 UTC. some webhooks returned 200 but we rejected later when verifying sig.
Rachel: we just got a webhook 400 from their side with `invalid_signature` in their logs. they say they rotated the signing key overnight. cc @cloudvendor on this channel? :eyes:
cloudvendor-bot: webhook id=wb_20260310_0512 delivered, status=accepted, signature=headers.X-Signature=sha256=abc123... (raw redacted)
Chris: if they rotated keys without coordination that explains the mismatches. can we capture one raw payload sample before we ack? need to replay for accounting.
Ana: @Rachel can you ping their partner eng and ask for the new public key/thumbprint + rotation time window? we need exact UTC timestamp to reconcile offsets.
Rachel: pinged them. they responded: "rotation started 05:10, completed 05:11:30 UTC, some retries were re-sent with old signature header" — asking for replay of failed deliveries.
Chris: plan: 1) fetch rejected webhook batch from our staging queue 05:10-05:20 2) run signature validation locally with their old key 3) replay accepted events into usage pipeline with original timestamps.
Mike: if replay changes billed units we'll need to run an invoice reconciliation. mark this as potential credit. i'll estimate $$ impact after replay.
Chris: verification command I used locally (for reference):
```
echo -n "$PAYLOAD" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$SHARED_SECRET" -binary | base64
```
match against X-Signature header (sha256=base64).
Rachel: they just pushed a replay zip with 230 events for that window. sharing S3 link privately.
DeployBot: replay job kicked: job_id=replay-174964-01, queued on ingestion-worker-3.
Ana: good. can we prioritize the replay so accounting has numbers today? also want to avoid double-counting — we should mark the replayed messages with `replay_source=partner-rotation-20260310` and track dedupe by their original event_id.
Chris: agreed. will add dedupe check in pipeline (skip if event_id already present). quick patch deployed to ingestion-worker-3.
Mike: once replay finishes, please post final tally (ingested tokens / embeddings / delta vs marketplace report). i'll prep a provisional credit note.
Rachel: partner confirmed they will keep both keys for 24h and provide signed list of rotated event_ids.
Ana: action items: Rachel -> collect rotation window + signed ids; Chris -> run replay, dedupe, post counts; Mike -> compute credit exposure; Rachel -> confirm replay integrity with partner. ETA EOD UTC.
Chris: starting replay now. will update in-thread. :hammer_and_wrench:
cloudvendor-bot: replay job delivered, 230 events; webhooks 05:10-05:20 UTC; signature scheme=HMAC-SHA256
Chris: replay finished. preliminary numbers: ingested 228/230 (2 duplicates dropped by dedupe). delta vs marketplace: +0.9% usage on our side after replay (marketplace reported higher before). full counts: ingested_tokens=1,240,122; marketplace_tokens_reported=1,251,859.
Mike: received numbers. looks like marketplace still shows ~0.95% higher — could be their rounding/batch aggregation windows. i'll open a ticket to join a 1:1 with their finance ops.
Ana: thanks team. keep this channel for any follow-ups. closing notes: require a documented key-rotation runbook with a handshake + pre-rotation test in future partner onboards. :memo:
